items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: I was named that French uncle of mine, you know. He emigrated from France here. Oh, yes. And he married my mother's sister, you see.

ctx.x: Yes. And what is your middle name? Is that B? B. Batiste. Batiste. And your name is Bat? Is that right? What? Do they call you Bat? Is that a nickname?
Yeah, that's a nickname, yeah. I was named that French uncle of mine, you know. He emigrated from France here. Oh, yes. And he married my mother's sister, you see.
